freeze_plan: Two-step freeze. Step 1 (this file, the pre-registration commit, before any seat runs): claims, predicates, targets, kill rules, the do-nothing and cheapest controls by definition, the R=3 repetition count, the C2 target set and its required phrases. Step 2 (the counter freeze, after wave 1 delivers the two counters and before any deciding or control scoring): the counters and their selftests are committed at the paths below with their sha256 recorded in freeze-2.json, and the controls are scored and committed. Neither step is amended after any claim has been scored; an amendment before scoring is recorded in `amendments` with its reason.

amendments.change: 'R's URL' means the set of https URLs appearing in R's source and anchor cells. T's base URL must be in that set, and the fetch receipt url (also the live-fetch url) must be in that set. Reason: S093's base URL is the GitHub blob page while the snapshot bytes are fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the same tag; the original wording 'url equal to R's URL' was ambiguous for that case.

Gate line format fixed: a line of corpus/lessons/round-48.md matching ^- C2-QUOTE (S[0-9]{3,}) (S[0-9]{3,}): `([^`]+)` names R, then T, then the quote. Extraction for 'located': decode UTF-8, drop <script> and <style> element contents, strip tags, html.unescape, collapse every whitespace run to one space; the quote (whitespace-collapsed) must be a substring of that text, with no case or punctuation folding (QUALITY 91). Word count = whitespace-split tokens of the quote.

Row grammar fixed. cap evidence cell: `CMD` → `LINE1`, exit N1[ or `LINE2`, exit N2[ or `LINE3`, exit N3]], tool sha256 `12 hex`, deps `LIST`, runs 3 CLASS. axis rows: score cell `N1[ or N2[ or N3]]`; evidence cell carries tool sha256 `12 hex`, deps `LIST`, runs 3 CLASS. CLASS is `stable` (exactly one member) or `nondeterministic` (two or three members); any other count/class pairing is `oversize`. LIST is `none` or a sorted comma list over {bwrap, env, fleet-root, jj, node}. A row whose evidence cell lacks `runs 3` is not a round-48 standing row and is skipped when picking the last row.

amendments.change: Attestation (F1): a member of V is attested only when the counter itself observes it at REV in the same invocation: as a P0 or P1 (line, exit) tuple in any of the three rounds (P1 is the clean full profile: same tools, clean environment), or in up to 6 extra P0 observations of that statement taken after the rounds (each in a fresh work dir; printed as `EXTRA` lines; the label prints `attested_extra=<n>`). An extra tuple outside V is a mismatch. A tuple seen only under a dependence-removing variant (P2-P5) never attests. Committed files under .ufo/evidence/round-48/calibration/observations/ are evidence for the report only, never attestation. Reason: a lane-authored receipt is unbound text and could attest any value (T48CritC1Design F1). P1 is admitted because T48RevenRegression (.ufo/waves/round-48/w1/T48RevenRegression.md, verdict 1-4) showed `six-leg regression ledger` is genuinely nondeterministic (a SIGPIPE race under pipefail in the pinned tsukuroi leg, ~10% of runs, one-sided PASS->FAIL), so an honest nondeterministic row needs more than three P0 runs to attest its rare member. Disclosed risk: a member flaking at rate p is attested with probability 1-(1-p)^12 (6 P0/P1 round runs + 6 extras); at p=0.1 that is ~0.72.

C1.type: standing self-assessment is stated from repeated observation (round-47 closure routed defect 1: a single flaky observation was restated as a standing value; N>=3 per profile or a declared nondeterministic class)
C1.surface: the last SCORECARD.md row carrying a `runs` clause for each of the 22 frozen statements of .ufo/evidence/round-47/calibration/statements.json (sha256 924102dfbc6135a7d9dabef7b8b2e681a5ce4c42ca72a031ea1f8d5ab9fb2e56, reused unchanged), against R=3 independent observation rounds of the round-47 six profiles
C1.statement: At REV, for each of the 22 frozen statements, the standing row (the last data row of a SCORECARD.md table of its kind whose first cell is the statement id AND whose evidence cell carries a `runs 3` clause) declares a value set V (one member: `stable`; two or three members: `nondeterministic`), the tool sha256 prefix and a deps set D, such that over R=3 observation rounds of the six profiles P0-P5: every observed P0 (line, exit) tuple is a member of V; every member of V is attested (observed in this run's P0 tuples or recorded as a P0 tuple of that statement in a committed observation receipt under .ufo/evidence/round-48/calibration/observations/ at REV); the tool sha256 prefix equals the pinned file at REV; and D contains every dependence observed in all 3 rounds and no dependence observed in none of them (a dependence observed in some rounds only is `unstable` and may be declared or omitted). Per round, dependence d is observed when the variant profile's tuple differs from that round's P1 tuple (env: P0 differs from P1); profiles and variants are the round-47 counter's. total = mismatches + unparsed + unobservable + dep_mismatch + unpinned + unattested + oversize = 0, the base SCORECARD.md stays a byte prefix, and the counter, its selftest and the statements pin are committed at REV.
C1.predicate_label: C1_R48_PASS=true iff self_pin=1 stmts_pin=1 statements=22 rounds=3 append_only=1 unpinned=0 total=0
C1.kill_rule: total>0 at the deciding run, or rounds<3, or a deciding run taken at a revision other than the content revision, is a miss; the target is never narrowed; a flaky deciding observation outside V is a mismatch, not a rerun.
C1.before_state: measured at freeze step 2 on the base tree: every row lacks a `runs` clause, so unparsed=22, total>=22, C1_R48_PASS=false
C1.do_nothing_control: CTL_A: the base tree unchanged -> must print C1_R48_PASS=false
C1.cheapest_controls: CTL_B relabel: the round-47 standing rows re-appended with `runs 3` and `stable` and their deps unchanged, no re-observation -> must print false (the six-leg row states FAIL passed=7); CTL_C superset cheat: every row declares three invented members -> must be refused as unattested; CTL_D deps-everything: every row declares all five dependences -> must print dep_mismatch>0; CTL_E positive: rows emitted by the counter's own --emit from the same observation run -> must print total=0 (the counter can pass at all).
C1.separability: C1 is verifiable without C2: its rows restate whatever the tree prints. The `sources-registry` statement prints the registry row count, so its row value tracks C2's row additions; C1 is measured at the content revision and its truth does not depend on C2 verifying.

C2.type: held-row live re-anchoring (carried from round 45: per-snapshot fetch receipts and anchor refresh for S026, S093, S108; round-45 non-author disputes of S048 and S093 quotes); sourced claim of the frontier step
C2.surface: four held SOURCES.md rows S026, S048, S093, S108 and the knowledge entries listed in their used-by cells at base
C2.statement: At REV, for each target T in {S026, S048, S093, S108}: exactly one new registry row R (id above S264) whose teaches cell opens `supersedes T —`, opened 2026-10-26, status mined, whose source cell carries T's URL; a committed snapshot .ufo/evidence/round-48/freshness/sources/T.* whose sha256 12-hex prefix appears in R's anchor cell; a committed fetch receipt .ufo/evidence/round-48/freshness/sources/T.receipt.json with url equal to R's URL, fetched_at on 2026-10-26, http_status 200 and sha256 equal to the snapshot's; a Gate line in corpus/lessons/round-48.md naming R and T with a quote of at most 25 words that is located in the snapshot's extracted text and contains T's required phrase(s); every knowledge entry in T's base used-by cell cites R in its `source:` line and carries `verified-at: 2026-10-26`, and R's used-by cell lists exactly those entries; at the deciding run a live fetch of the URL contains the quote (extracted text). refreshed counts targets meeting all of these.
C2.predicate_label: C2_R48_PASS=true iff self_pin=1 targets=4 refreshed=4 census_exit=0
C2.kill_rule: refreshed<4 or a census error (exit != 0) at the deciding run is a miss; a target whose live fetch fails at the deciding run is not refreshed (unreachable is reported, never credited).
C2.before_state: measured at freeze step 2 on the base tree: refreshed=0
C2.do_nothing_control: CTL_F: the base tree unchanged -> refreshed=0, false
C2.cheapest_controls: CTL_G rows-only: four superseding rows pointing at the round-45 snapshots, no round-48 snapshot or receipt, entries untouched -> refreshed=0; CTL_H quote-without-phrase: the round-45 quotes re-used verbatim (S048 and S093 lack their required phrases) -> refreshed<=2.
C2.separability: C2 is verifiable without C1: it reads SOURCES.md, the lesson Gate lines, the entries and the snapshots, never SCORECARD.md.
